instructions.title_he: ירי רקטות וטילים - היכנסו למרחב המוגן
instructions.title: Missile and rocket attack - Enter protected space
instructions.instructions: Enter a protected space within the time you have available to reach shelter.

instructions.title_he: כלי טייס עוין - היכנסו מייד למרחב המוגן
instructions.title: Hostile aerial vehicle - Enter protected space now
instructions.instructions: Enter a protected space as quickly as possible.

instructions.title: Hostile aerial vehicle event has ended
instructions.instructions: Following the activation of an alert on the infiltration of a hostile aerial vehicle into Israeli skies - the event has ended.

instructions.title_he: חדירת מחבלים - היכנסו מייד למרחב המוגן
instructions.title: Terrorist infiltration - Enter protected space now
instructions.instructions: Enter a protected space immediately, close the door tightly, and sit below the window line. If there is no protected space - enter a hiding place. Do not exit until you receive an explicit guideline from official authorities.

instructions.title: Terrorist infiltration threat has been removed
instructions.instructions: Fear of a terrorist infiltration event has been ruled out; residents may leave their homes and travel in the area without restriction.

instructions.title: Terrorist infiltration event
instructions.instructions: Terrorist infiltration has been identified in your area. Stay in the protected space and sit below the window line. Travelling in the area is prohibited. The IDF and security forces are handling the event.

instructions.title: Terrorist infiltration event has ended
instructions.instructions: The terrorist infiltration event in your area has ended. You may leave your homes and travel in the area without restriction.

instructions.title: Earthquake - Go out to an open area
instructions.instructions: Go out immediately to an open area. If not possible, enter a residential protected room (Mamad) and leave the door open or go out to the stairwell. Only if these actions are not possible - sit in an inner corner of the room or under heavy furniture and protect your head with your hands.

instructions.title: Earthquake - Go out to an open area
instructions.instructions: Go out immediately to an open area. If not possible, enter a residential protected room (Mamad) and leave the door open or go out to the stairwell. Only if these actions are not possible - sit in an inner corner of the room or under heavy furniture and protect your head with your hands.

instructions.title_he: אירוע חומרים מסוכנים - הסתגרו מייד במבנה
instructions.title: HAZMAT incident - Seclude indoors immediately
instructions.instructions: Due to fear of hazardous materials incident, enter a building immediately - close doors and windows and turn off air conditioner. Do not leave the building until you receive explicit guideline. Travel in the area is prohibited. In open area - move away from the area. If traveling in vehicle - stop on the side and close windows and air conditioning

instructions.title_he: אירוע חומרים מסוכנים - המשך הסתגרות במבנה
instructions.title: Continue staying secluded indoors!
instructions.instructions: Due to fear of a hazardous materials incident in your area, continue staying indoors, make sure the doors and windows are closed, and the air conditioner is turned off. Do not leave the building until you receive an explicit guideline.

instructions.title: Negation of hazardous materials danger
instructions.instructions: Based on the risk assessment performed, there is no danger in your area. You may now stop staying secluded indoors.

instructions.title: End of hazardous materials incident
instructions.instructions: Following the handling of the hazardous materials incident in your area - the danger has passed and you may now stop staying secluded indoors.

instructions.title_he: חשש לצונמי - התרחקו מייד מחוף הים
instructions.title: Fear of Tsunami - Move away from the beach now
instructions.instructions: Immediately move at least one kilometer away from the beach, and if not possible, go up to the fourth floor or higher in a nearby building.

instructions.title: Enter the protected space immediately!
instructions.instructions: Enter the protected space immediately and stay there until you receive an explicit guideline. Leaving the protected space at this time is life-threatening.

instructions.title: Continue staying in the protected space!
instructions.instructions: Stay in the protected space until you receive an explicit guideline.

instructions.title: End of stay in the protected space
instructions.instructions: You may exit the protected space.

instructions.title: Exiting the protected space and staying nearby
instructions.instructions: You may exit the protected space, but must stay near it and avoid travel outdoors unless for an essential purpose.

instructions.title: Stay near the protected space
instructions.instructions: Stay near a protected space that allows you to reach it within a few minutes, and avoid non-essential travel.

instructions.title: Continue staying near the protected space
instructions.instructions: Continue to stay near a protected space and avoid staying or traveling outdoors unless for an essential purpose.

instructions.title: End of stay near the protected space
instructions.instructions: There is no longer a need to stay near a protected space.

instructions.title: Move closer to the protected space
instructions.instructions: In the next few minutes, alerts are expected in your area. You must improve your location to the optimal protection near you. In the event of an alert, enter the protected space and stay there until you receive an explicit guideline.

instructions.title: Stay near the protected space
instructions.instructions: Stay near a protected space that can be reached within the time available to reach shelter, and avoid travel that is not for an essential purpose.

instructions.title_he: סכנת פיצוץ והדף חזק - המשך שהייה במרחב המוגן
instructions.title: Continue staying in the protected space
instructions.instructions: Due to the danger of explosion and strong blast at a factory in your area, stay in the protected space until you receive an explicit guideline.

instructions.title: End of explosion and blast danger event
instructions.instructions: The explosion and blast danger event at the factory in your area has ended. You may leave the protected space.

instructions.title: Increasing readiness
instructions.instructions: Due to preparations for a significant threat, it is required to follow the Home Front Command guidelines currently being broadcast across all media outlets.

instructions.title: The event has ended
instructions.instructions: Those staying in the protected space may exit. Upon receiving a guideline or alert, act according to Home Front Command guidelines.

instructions.title: Danger of explosion and strong blast
instructions.instructions: Due to the danger of explosion and strong blast at a factory in your area, enter the protected space immediately until you receive an explicit guideline.

instructions.title: Radiological incident- Seclude indoors immediately
instructions.instructions: Following the incident at Negev Nuclear Research Center, enter a building, close doors and windows and turn off air conditioner. Do not leave the building until an explicit guideline. Travel in the area is prohibited. Security forces are operating on-site performing all necessary actions.

instructions.title: Radiological incident- Seclude indoors immediately!
instructions.instructions: Following the incident at Soreq Nuclear Research Center, enter a building, close doors and windows and turn off air conditioner. Do not leave the building until an explicit guideline. Travel in the area is prohibited. Security forces are operating on-site performing all necessary actions.

instructions.title: Public announcement:
instructions.instructions: Following the event in the Negev Nuclear Research Center area - the public is not required to take special actions. Continue to stay updated on guidelines distributed by official sources.

instructions.title: Public announcement
instructions.instructions: Following the event in the Soreq Nuclear Research Center area - the public is not required to take special actions. Continue to stay updated on guidelines distributed by official sources.

instructions.title: False earthquake alert
instructions.instructions: An inspection by the Geological Institute shows that no earthquake occurred in our area. You may return to full routine.

instructions.title: Following an Earthquake –  Returning to Buildings
instructions.instructions: Following the earthquake, you may return to homes that have no visible damage. In the event of another earthquake, act according to the guidelines and reach a safe place immediately.

instructions.title: Earthquake - Stay in an open area
instructions.instructions: Following the earthquake, stay in an open area until you receive an explicit guideline. Stay away from buildings, trees, and power poles, and follow the guidelines of the security and rescue forces in the field. Stay updated on guidelines distributed by official sources.

instructions.title: Move toward a protected space
instructions.instructions: In the next few minutes, alerts are expected in your area. You must improve your location to the optimal protection near you. In the event of an alert, enter the protected space and stay there for 10 minutes.

instructions.title: Increasing readiness
instructions.instructions: Due to security situation, there is potential threat to Israeli home front. Advance personal and family readiness and preparedness, remain alert: Identify and prepare your optimal protected space, install Home Front Command app, and make sure all family members know the guidelines.

instructions.title_he: אירוע צונמי - הישארו הרחק מחוף הים
instructions.title: Fear of Tsunami - Stay far away from the beach
instructions.instructions: Following a tsunami event that occurred on Israel's shores, do not return to areas near the coast for the next 12 hours. Security forces are working to rescue trapped individuals and provide aid to the injured. Continue to stay updated on messages distributed through the media.

instructions.title: Removal of tsunami warning
instructions.instructions: An alert regarding the fear of a tsunami was activated. A situational assessment shows that a tsunami is not expected to hit our area. You may return to full routine.

instructions.title_he: סיום אירוע בקרייה למחקר גרעיני בנגב
instructions.title: End of incident at Negev Nuclear Research Center
instructions.instructions: Following the event that occurred at the Negev Nuclear Research Center, you may now stop staying secluded indoors.

instructions.title_he: סיום אירוע במרכז למחקר גרעיני בשורק
instructions.title: End of incident at Soreq Nuclear Research Center
instructions.instructions: Following the event that occurred at the Soreq Nuclear Research Center, you may now stop staying secluded indoors.

instructions.title: Sirens disruptions
instructions.instructions: Sirens from the Home Front Command may not be heard in your area. Alerts can be received via the app, the Home Front Command website, and media outlets.

instructions.title_he: שיבושים במערך הצופרים - שהו במרחב המוגן
instructions.title: Stay in the protected space
instructions.instructions: There are disruptions in the siren system and alerts may not be received. Stay in the protected space until the ability to distribute alerts is restored.

instructions.title: Siren system has returned to operation
instructions.instructions: The Home Front Command siren system has returned to normal operation.

instructions.title: Increasing readiness
instructions.instructions: Following the security situation, make sure you know the optimal protected space near you, install the Home Front Command app, and avoid non-essential travel. Continue to follow guidelines, and consume information via official channels.

instructions.title: Threat from Lebanon- Move close to protected space
instructions.instructions: A launch toward your area has been identified. Alerts may be received within a short time; move closer to a protected space now. In the event of an alert, enter the protected space and remain there until you receive an explicit guideline.
